title: Putting Off and Putting On
definition: Putting Off and Putting On is the biblical pattern of rejecting sinful ways and embracing new conduct fitting for life in Christ.
summary: Putting Off and Putting On describes the believer's daily rejection of the old life and practice of the new life in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ has made believers new, so they are called to put off the old self and put on Christlike character.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on intentional change. Christians are called to put off sinful patterns and put on Christlike virtues, not merely feel regret. It gives practical shape to sanctification by naming both what must be removed and what must replace it.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because repentance stalls when believers only stop at 'I should not do that.' Scripture calls for replacement: lies with truth, stealing with generosity, bitterness with forgiveness, impurity with holiness. This doctrine gives hope for concrete growth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Identify one old pattern to put off and one Christlike practice to put on. Use Scripture to name both sides clearly. Invite accountability where repeated habits need persistent grace and truth.
